reviews.title: Update removed most of my athkar
reviews.text: I don’t know what happened. Last update removed most of my athkar and replaced them with a different list I didn’t ask for. I’ve been using this app for a long time now and I’m extremely disappointed. Not sure it would even be worth going back and making my list again if it could just be wiped out in an update. I hope something can be done to fix that and guarantee it won’t happen again. Jazakum Allah khair for your efforts.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Was using this for all my zikrs for my deceased dad, updated to newest version and now the app doesn’t work or load at all, lost count of all of it so upset
